name: io.github.cyanheads/epa-drinking-water-mcp-server
description: Search EPA drinking water systems, violations, enforcement, and contaminant measurements.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Optional SQL staging in the npm runtime: none or duckdb.

environmentVariables.name: SDWIS_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable removal of staged tables when DataCanvas is enabled.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_DEFAULT_ROW_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: SQL retained-row ceiling; the server maximum is 25000.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_DEFAULT_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB
environmentVariables.description: DuckDB memory budget per engine in MiB; maximum 512.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
